plan.explanation: Plan starts with face milling F1 to establish the datum. Holes are processed sequentially (F2, F3, F4, F5, F6, F9) on M2 for drilling/tapping and M4/M3 for specific operations where compatible, respecting drill-then-tap/ream precedence. Pockets F7, F8, F10 are milled on M4 after datum establishment. A specific constraint requires F7 (pocket) to be completed before F5 (blind hole starting at its floor), so OP16 is scheduled before OP11.
assumptions: Synthetic component generated for software evaluation; not derived from real geometry.
Tool size, tool access, collisions and setups are not modelled.
Precedence constraints are generated demo assumptions, not general manufacturing rules.
uncertainties: Is F5 intended to be machined after F7 or independently? The constraint forces F7 before F5.
Can M2 (Drill-tap unit) perform 'drilling' without prior 'spot_drilling'? Catalogue allows both, but physical tooling might differ.
